strategies.title: Syntax recursion to evidence
strategies.title_ko: 귀납 대상을 증거·trace에 맞추거나 관계 정리로 귀납 제거
strategies.guide: If syntax recursion repeatedly reconstructs typing, semantics, or execution facts, consider induction on their derivation or trace. First check for a theorem relating the executable function to an inductive relation; it may eliminate recursion entirely.
strategies.risks: The evidence induction hypothesis must generalize environments and result types sufficiently. Do not change the statement or recursively use the target theorem.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Share parametric subproof
strategies.title_ko: 반복 논증을 매개변수화한 국소 보조정리로 공유
strategies.guide: Identify an actually repeated subderivation, abstract only its varying arguments into one local helper, and replace the repeated proofs. Keep independent assumptions explicit and verify elaboration at each call site.
strategies.risks: A helper can increase inference cost or capture accidental context. Repeated surface text alone is insufficient to establish a reusable proposition.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Factor common branches
strategies.title_ko: 공통 분기 준비와 마무리를 묶기
strategies.guide: Find genuinely identical branch preparation or endings. Hoist shared intros and simplification, combine compatible constructor cases, then keep exceptional branches separate. Prefer sufficient local rules for the common ending.
strategies.risks: Different dependent indices or assumptions can make superficially similar branches incompatible. Uniform heavy search can increase heartbeats.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title_ko: 자동 탐색을 명시적 사실·정리·문맥으로 제한
strategies.guide: Inspect one broad search. Replace it with an available constructor, inversion theorem, equality rewrite or explicit arithmetic facts. Alternatively use a sufficient only-list and remove irrelevant local hypotheses from that search scope.
strategies.risks: Occurrence counts are not tactic costs. Do not reuse generated local-fact hashes across contexts; reconstruct the required facts and check pinned versions.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Administrative proof contraction
strategies.title_ko: 단일 사용 사실·불필요한 래퍼·추론 부담 정리
strategies.guide: Inspect a named local fact with at most one explicit later use or a by-exact wrapper. Inline a direct term when types still infer, or remove truly unused construction. Keep named equality witnesses where unfolding an expensive definition would be harmful.
strategies.risks: Automation can use a fact with zero explicit textual uses. This is only a candidate-use scan; dependency and elaboration checks are required.

strategies.risks: Enumeration can duplicate work. Preserve the kernel-checked route; native bypasses are not interchangeable.

strategies.title: Pullback ring hom expression
strategies.title_ko: 사상 아래 등식을 원래 대수 구조로 되돌리기
strategies.guide: Use the available map-add/map-mul/map-neg identities backwards to express both sides as images of algebraic expressions. Prove the preimage equality and transport it with congruence; retain exact scalar signs and product order.
strategies.risks: Do not assume a map is injective. Congruence can transport a preimage equality; a reverse inference requires a proved injectivity theorem. Check scalar conventions.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title_ko: 선형·다중선형 구조의 ext/map API로 전개 대체

strategies.risks: Linearity in each argument must be established. Basis orientation and scalar conventions matter; imported target declarations cannot be used circularly.

strategies.title: Positive matrix certificate
strategies.title_ko: 행렬 양성을 Schur·합동 이차형식 인증으로 증명
strategies.guide: For a positive matrix inequality, search for a block/Schur-complement theorem before expanding coordinates. An alternative is a PSD congruence quadratic form whose weighted sum is the desired residual. Separate zero-coefficient boundary cases.
strategies.risks: Positive definiteness, invertibility and nonnegative weights are genuine obligations. The two certificates are alternative recipes, not two independent performance wins.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Weaken to sufficient bound
strategies.title_ko: 정확한 크기·표현 대신 필요한 상계·단조성만 증명
strategies.guide: Check the direction actually required by the final inequality. If only an upper bound is needed, use image/union cardinal bounds or event implication monotonicity rather than proving an exact cardinality, disjointness, or an equivalent probability representation.
strategies.risks: Weakening is valid only in the required inequality direction. Do not discard exactness needed later; event measurability and finite-fiber assumptions still apply.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Normalize then algebra certificate
strategies.title_ko: 분모·cast를 정규화하고 대수 인증식으로 마무리
strategies.guide: Normalize coercions and nonzero denominators once. Use explicit ring identities, linear combinations of existing equalities, or a small sufficient inequality list. When possible do counting arithmetic in naturals/integers and cast only at the boundary.
strategies.risks: Track denominator signs, truncated natural subtraction, and square-root nonnegativity. A certificate must follow from actual hypotheses; ring normalization does not prove inequalities.
strategies.constraints: Use only facts available before the target in the pinned module. Preserve statement and validate the complete candidate in required versions.

strategies.title: Continuous test function zero
strategies.title_ko: 연속성·test function으로 영함수 목표 환원

strategies.risks: Borel/trim, local integrability and positivity assumptions must be proved. The scalarization alone does not imply the vector equality without the self-inner-product argument.

strategies.title: Compositional continuity control
strategies.title_ko: 연속성 API와 명시적 거리·콤팩트 제어 활용

strategies.risks: A pointwise bound is not automatically uniform. Keep compactness, boundary values and positive radii explicit; fun_prop cannot discharge missing analytic assumptions.

strategies.title: Finite state pigeonhole
strategies.title_ko: 유한 상태 반복을 직접 비둘기집 정리로 얻기
strategies.guide: Package the recurrence history into a finite-dimensional state and prove it maps into a finite bounded set. Apply infinite-to-finite collision existence directly, order the two indices, then propagate equal states using the recurrence.
strategies.risks: The state must include every dependency of the recurrence. A repeated state is not yet eventual periodicity; prove propagation and a positive period.

strategies.title_ko: stateful 실행에서 필요한 값의 support만 투영

strategies.risks: Projection loses information. Do not use it for a goal that still requires the final state, and verify the support theorem for the exact transformer stack.

strategies.title_ko: 정수 잔여류 논증을 유한 quotient로 옮기기
